pages.title: Structure and ownership
pages.text: Bottom/top: World Barriers at corners, chains at edge centres, World Shard Miner at bottom centre and Treasure Basin at top centre. Middle: chains at corners, air at edge centres and a Miniature Immortal Ruin at centre. Ownership is recorded when placing the ruin. Other machines' enable state and ownership do not affect formation.

pages.name: Full Structure: Compression
pages.text: Project with the bottom World Shard Miner as anchor; aim at the ground to place the full structure. Upper/lower chains follow X/Z and middle corner chains follow Y. Sneak empty-hand right-click the central ruin to reverse it.

pages.name: Full Structure: Decompression
pages.text: Project with the bottom World Shard Miner as anchor; aim at the ground to place the full structure. Upper/lower chains follow X/Z and middle corner chains follow Y. Sneak empty-hand right-click the central ruin to reverse it.

pages.name: Bottom Layer: y=-1
pages.text: Four World Barriers at corners, four chains at edge centres, World Shard Miner at centre.

pages.name: Middle Layer: y=0
pages.text: Four chains at corners, four air cells at edge centres and the ruin at centre. Reversal changes only the core state.

pages.name: Top Layer: y=+1
pages.text: Four World Barriers at corners, four chains at edge centres, Treasure Basin at centre.

pages.title: Materials and Assembly
pages.text: Materials: 8 World Barriers, 12 chains, 1 World Shard Miner, 1 Treasure Basin and 1 Miniature Immortal Ruin. Build bottom to top and keep the air cells empty. Auxiliary enable state and ownership are ignored. The core placer owns the machine. JEI/EMI contain production recipes; placement guidance lives here.

pages.title: Batched compression
pages.text: Right-click the formed centre for twelve inputs and one output. Each tick, recipes with the largest input requirement run first at their maximum whole multiplier. Identical outputs accumulate in bulk; incompatible or full output stops further local processing without spending the blocked recipe's inputs. The formed ruin suspends its force field. Chains emit sparse cyan-white particles moving inward.

pages.title: Spirit Forging Decompressor
pages.text: The reversed core uses one left input and twelve right outputs. Each tick processes the whole ore stack: cobblestone or deepslate plus four times minimum unenchanted drops (copper 8, redstone/lapis 16, others 4). All results must fit before consuming input; direct Xianqiao output bypasses local slots. Switching mode ejects cached inputs and outputs while sharing configuration.

pages.title: Faces and redstone
pages.text: Open the gear panel. Each face cycles closed, passive input, passive output, active input and active output. Active transfers share a 64-item budget per face per tick. Ports lie on the matching outer faces of the structure. The existing three-state redstone button gates production and active transfers; passive ports remain available. Configuration and inventory persist in the ruin; breaking the structure pauses processing.

pages.title: Direct Xianqiao output
pages.text: When enabled, all craftable recipes run at their complete multiplier in the same tick, writing directly to the ruin placer's Xianqiao without the local output-slot bottleneck or external output. The owner must be online with Xianqiao unlocked; otherwise materials remain. Existing cached output is returned first. Example: 768 diamonds produce 192 Immortal Yuan in one tick, locally or directly in Xianqiao.

pages.title: Sources and datapacks
pages.text: Default inversion follows item-source ratios: 4 diamonds yield 1 Immortal Yuan; 1 echo shard yields 16. Free sources yield no default Yuan; fluids are excluded. spirit_compression datapack recipes can override ratios or produce other items. Inputs that generate Yuan remain restricted to source resources. JEI/EMI show the server-resolved compression/decompression recipes. Structure projection and layer diagrams are in this handbook. See the project data-driven documentation for JSON schemas.
